Subject: SI-OC-0006 Rack optical cable assembly (rev A) — request for additional qualification information

Dear Stane International team,

Thank you for your qualification packet for part SI-OC-0006, drawing SI-DWG-OC-0006. To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 4.workmanship_620 — Workmanship to IPC/WHMA-A-620: an inspection record showing the assemblies are built and inspected to the drawing class (Class 2), including the inspection reject count. Your reliability report §1.2 states this but includes no record.
2. 6.lead_time — Lead time: a quoted lead time in weeks for this part. Capacity §1.1 says you can deliver within the requested schedule but gives no figure; our need-by lead time is 8 weeks.
3. 8.flowdown — Sub-tier requirements flowdown: evidence that Stark requirements are flowed down to your critical sub-tier (e.g. a purchase order or purchase instruction to Wakanda Design Group showing the flowed-down requirements).

Please reply with these documents at your earliest convenience.

Regards,
Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: On the cable assembly line, review IPC/WHMA-A-620 inspection records for SI-OC-0006: confirm inspection is to Class 2 per the drawing, inspectors are trained to A-620, and the reject count meets Stark's limit of 0 (claim at reliability_report.md §1.2).

Walk through order-to-ship planning for SI-OC-0006 and obtain a quoted lead time in weeks; verify it is at or under Stark's 8-week need-by, given the stated claim at capacity.md §1.1 and the 2026-11-01 ramp milestone.

Pull a recent purchase order/purchase instruction to Wakanda Design Group and confirm Stark's requirements (change approval, traceability, quality clauses) are flowed down, as claimed at subtier.md §1.2.
